note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published by PlayStation. Every guide below is written in our own words; the sources named beside each guide are where the facts were checked, and no guide text is copied from them.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. There is no shortcut: finish the story, work the 100% Completion Checklist, then clean up the Strangers & Freaks strands and any remaining activities. The platinum pops the moment the 54th trophy unlocks. Budget around 200 hours; PowerPyx rates the set 4 out of 10 in difficulty, so it is long rather than hard.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. You cannot miss it; it unlocks as the story opens.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete Chapter 1. It unlocks when you start the first main mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?' — just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete Chapter 2. It unlocks when you start the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete Chapter 3. It unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete Chapter 4. It unlocks after the final main mission of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero'.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the final mission of the story. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save from just before the finale, then finish the last mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the story mission 'Breakfast Run' in Chapter 2. It unlocks as part of the main story; you cannot miss it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the story mission 'The Cartel Heist' in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the story mission 'Child's Play' in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the story mission 'Headliners' in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the story mission 'VCIA Takedown' in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the story mission 'Operation Savage Glory' in Chapter 5.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; progress you make during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. The requirements are lenient (roughly 60% true completion): 100 optional missions, scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 70 of 80 challenges, plus all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's Target Decks. Finish the story first, then work the checklist in free-roam.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts (100% completion needs 300). The four kinds are 130 Stunt Jumps (jumping over ramps), 202 Under the Bridges (flying under bridges), 40 Knife Flights (flying between buildings) and 25 Base Jumps (parachute challenges). Mix the kinds; Under the Bridges are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball (scoring hoops), playing a Video Game, winning a Car Race / Race Challenge / Top Fun Drone Race, and performing a Stunt. View them in Touchpad > Progress > Activities; the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) marks most of them. You will do one of each naturally while working on the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting ranges. Work through each range's challenges and aim for gold on every one. The gold medals are not too difficult, and the ranges also raise your Focus, which helps with Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total). The races are marked on the map; win at least one race at each of the 14 spots. Drone races also count toward race wins and the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations (car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races). Win any 20 distinct ones; each location counts once. Track them on the map and in Progress > Activities.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui (Meet Cal)', Cal texts you a fishing location (purple icon on the map). Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in the challenge he sets.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. There are 4 Video Games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home (interact with the controllers) from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. To complete a game, finish all of its levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge. Pick whichever game you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia. While playing as Lucia in Chapter 3 you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address in Belville. Complete her 5 quests: 'Climbing the Cellerichain' (Parts 1-3), 'Pay the Cellerica Fee', 'Peach!' (Join the Cellerica Initiation), 'Read the Label' (Retrieve the Cellerica Van) and 'Puff Puff Pass' (Meet at the Warehouse). All quests remain available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. After the mission 'Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)' he calls you and is marked by the green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. He sends you on treasure-diving quests: find the underwater treasures he marks (purple chest icons) and bring them back, using the metal detector to dig them from the ocean floor. Clear all 7 shipwrecks. Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. Kenton is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (as Jason he texts you; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up).

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests: 'Thrillbillies' (Check Out the Mud Club), 'Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab' (Join Billy on a Job), 'Mall Rats' (Join Billy on a Job), 'The Impaler' (Steal the Impaler) and 'Hometown Heroes' (Join Billy on a Job). All quests remain available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not). Confirmed counting strands: Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests: 'Search for the Skunk Ape', 'Search for Tree Effigies', 'Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove'), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, 'Collect Chemicals for Kyle', 'Buddy?'), Yago (street racing strand: 'Join a Street Race', 'Bumper to Bumper', 'Race Against Yago', 'Brother to Brother') and Pilot Pete ('The Last Mile' deliveries). More strands are still being discovered. Note: Yago's 'Race Against Yago' in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive (hourglass icon), so do it when it appears. All strands remain available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's 'Wish List' questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy)', which also unlocks the Key Cloner. Randy wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green 'RK' icon, west Vice City). He marks some cars in fixed locations; you can also steal them off the street — scan a car with the Waink app to see if it is on the list, then drive it back (in good condition for more pay). The cars are often found in east Vice City at Vice Beach / Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. The 16 cars include the Granforma Zorrusso (delivered during the story mission), Pegassi Vitello, Pegassi Infernus, Buckingham Windsor Drop, Pegassi Toros, Pegassi Tempesta, Ascot Paragon, Ocelot Jagular, Buckingham Jubilee, Grotti Itali RSX, Pfister Growler, Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire, Piccia Furia, Benefactor Dubsta, Bravado Banshee and Gallivanter Baller ST-D. It can all be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty' and is only available as Jason. Purple markers show the Synthetic Labs in Vice City; destroy them in the quest 'Take Out Kitty Litter'. After destroying enough labs, Tyrone gives the second quest 'Spin On This' (Shut Down the Labs), which unlocks the trophy. All of it remains available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia (meditating at a spot with both counts as +2). Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: the first meditation is only available in Chapter 1, at Jason's house. After the mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her and choose 'Accept' when prompted. This meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so it is not confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it — PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so do it to be safe. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters are playable together (after Chapter 2, 'Coffee Break'). For 100% completion you only need 15 of 18 spots.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break'. As Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest 'Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret)' in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive it; the questline is exclusive to Jason). Bret then marks hunting spots (purple icons); hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' (retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation). A clean one-shot kill leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks, all needed for 100%, so this comes naturally. Which exact animal unlocks the trophy is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets hidden around Leonida; complete any 3 full sets. (100% completion needs 15 of the 18 sets, so you will pass 3 on the way.) The cards are a collectible type you find while exploring; use the in-game collectible tracking and a map of card locations to finish sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK scans are objects in the environment: hold Up + R1 to scan them. There are well over 100 to find (31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags), so it does not matter which 100 you scan. Scan anything that prompts as you explore; the count is tracked in the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in total; 100% completion needs any 70, so this trophy unlocks on the way. View and track them under Progress > Challenges (the checkmark in the bottom right shows completed). Many complete naturally while working on other trophies; save this for late, then pick the easiest remaining ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right + Triangle. Cause carnage until you reach 4 stars, then escape: a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works well, and shoot down any helicopter chasing you. The easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County): the police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red 'heat' wanted zone (not just the flashing search area). It also unlocks naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' and the bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4-star wanted levels.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Only after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break' (character switching). Call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), then hit 3 robbery targets (green icons) while staying wanted the whole time — keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation) and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. Loot 3 shops in a row; if it does not unlock after the 3rd, hit a 4th. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop. A good spot is the 3 Jewelry Stores in north Vice City (available after Chapter 3, 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'): rob a couple of items in each and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. If you leave the first store before the police arrive, you may need a 4th store.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. There are 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). Use the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. (100% needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this comes naturally.) Track discovered vehicles under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar (top left, below health and stamina). You must kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in that one use, which only lasts a few seconds. Prepare first: buff focus with food/drinks or by washing your face/showering at home, consume Adrenaline to extend it (hold L1, press Triangle), wear body armor (Ammu-Nation) and use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556. Line up 5 enemies — criminals at Gang Operations work well. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus, purple eye); raise it via Shooting Ranges, Golf, Pool, fishing and headshots. You will reach Focus Level 4 naturally, and the trophy often pops on its own.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not the planes parked on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge (the door leads directly inside); you can also enter on foot through the terminal. Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The unlock is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate (or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), get in a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs': it unlocks the Snap Gun (to silently lockpick alarmed doors) and Jewelry Store Robberies (green icons, marked automatically in unfogged areas). Break in through the back door using the Snap Gun — it stays in your inventory permanently, no need to equip it; when you approach a locked door you can kick it (triggers the alarm) or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. Inside, go to the back room, find the note with the safe code and use it to loot the safe. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)' (marked automatically from story progress) — it introduces bank vault robberies. Tail a security van until it stops at a bank; a guard carries a briefcase of cash in and the vault opens. Go in while it is open and rob it; you cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hold Right to hand off a bag. After that quest, pay Yasmani (the fence from Chapter 3) for security-van tips — do his earlier quests first (robbing 2 Payday Loans), then he sells tips for $10,000 and marks the vans with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level: escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 Large Bank Jobs in total; you need any 5 for this trophy but all 8 for 100%, and each bank pays up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. This unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)' — the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies: tailing the armored truck to a bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). You need all 8 Large Bank Jobs for 100%, so it comes naturally. Earlier method: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests; Yasmani is unlocked as a fence in Chapter 3, 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map (52 areas). The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations; you only need one operation per gang for this trophy, but all 39 for 100%. They are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track them under Progress > Gangs — scroll over a gang and the bottom right shows how many of its operations you have robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by any guide — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. The official description points to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach: order a cocktail at a bar with an ocean view there. Treat this as unconfirmed and check back for an update once a guide pins it down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue 'Banshee' from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy)'. Hack into the car, drive forward through the window — the trophy pops shortly after you drive away on the street. Only this specific blue Banshee works; it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a gang operation in Port Gellhorn. Go during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling' (marked automatically). Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first — you need them to destroy the safe. Inside, collect: the luxury watch in the south-east office (golden icon), the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon), and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it up with sticky bombs). The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. You do not need all 3 in one go: if you miss one, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can return for the rest, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength via Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (select a character) > Strength (heart icon). Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out: buy a membership at a fitness club (filter for them on Map > Activities, dumbbell icon; there are many around Vice City), or work out at home after the story. Always go together with both characters (hold Right + Triangle to call your partner): while one actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. View your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) so a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. The profiles are Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, or driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable (a permanent status from excessive violence — avoid it, as police become more aggressive). This happens passively while working on other trophies; if it is still missing at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The trigger is not yet confirmed by any guide — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Treat this as unconfirmed: keep an eye on the Payday Loans locations and on guide updates. Do not rely on an unverified method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The trigger is not yet confirmed by any guide — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be tied to a UFO questline. Treat this as unconfirmed and check guide updates once the UFO content is pinned down.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The exact method is not yet confirmed by any guide — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. Treat this as unconfirmed: the leading guess is a melee attack (kick) from a moving motorcycle. Check guide updates for the confirmed method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)' to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies; you do not need to bring it at once. It comes naturally while doing robberies for 100%. Bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery (unlocked after the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…').

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every shop type. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. Shop counts: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story-related garages do not count), costing $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)'; you get a notification that a new phone app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed — buy the garages through it. A quick way to make money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)'. It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then in his garage click 'Respray' and 'Register'. Moses initially only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
